subjects.subject: catalog
subjects.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: clean source for deterministic tonal-dot artwork on an e-commerce website. Scene: pure white seamless background, no floor line and no cast shadow. Composition: single complete subject centered, three-quarter isometric view with generous white margin on all sides. Subject: One open desktop card-file tray with five staggered upright product record sheets. Each sheet has a small blank image rectangle and two broad recessed horizontal lines, no text. The front page sits slightly forward and the others fan gently behind it. Make the tray lip and page edges clearly readable. Material and lighting: matte medium graphite-gray material; clear broad light and dark shaded faces, bright but not white highlights, defined dark side planes. Elegant premium 3D product render with simple readable volume. Constraints: no text, lettering, numbers, logos, ASCII characters, dots, decorative pattern, crop or secondary subject. The render will be converted into dots later; render clean smooth surfaces only.
